changes.note: Use intrinsics.reference for NVFP4 and MXFP4 linear weight preparation with the pinned FlashInfer.

changes.title: Rewrite flash_attn.cute imports to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.cute
changes.note: Packaging repair for this builder's symlink install path, which skips the import rewrite the upstream CMake copy performs. It carries no upstream change.

changes.title: C S3-FIFO host row cache for disk PLE/Engram tables
changes.note: Five PR commits plus the caller-gated DiskTable.prefetch and host row-id commits, all rebased onto main 9c9e94ef9aff as 0a2c4387a, then carried onto that base as 5f071af37. vLLM's prefetch hook needs the row-cache commit 0b6e5ee8b or later.
